title: Minestrone Soup
summary: A hearty Italian vegetable soup with onion, carrot, celery, beans, green beans, and small pasta simmered in an herb-flecked tomato broth. Finish each bowl with parsley, a pinch of red pepper flakes, and optional Parmesan.

items.original_text: 1 teaspoon sea salt, plus more to taste
items.name: sea salt
black pepper
items.notes: freshly ground; several grinds, to taste

items.original_text: 1½ cups cooked white beans or kidney beans, drained and rinsed
items.name: white beans or kidney beans

items.original_text: ¾ cup small pasta, elbows, shells, orecchiette
items.name: small pasta
red pepper flakes
items.notes: optional, for heat; amount not specified

items.original_text: Grated Parmesan cheese, optional, for serving
items.name: Parmesan cheese

items: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion, carrots, celery, salt, and several grinds of black pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 8 minutes, until the vegetables begin to soften.
Add the garlic, diced tomatoes, beans, green beans, vegetable broth, bay leaves, oregano, and thyme. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the pasta and cook uncovered for 10 more minutes, until the pasta is cooked through.
Season to taste. Serve topped with parsley, red pepper flakes, and Parmesan if desired.

notes: Best soon after cooking: the pasta keeps absorbing broth as leftovers sit.
To make ahead, cook the pasta separately and stir it into bowls when serving; or skip the pasta and add an extra cup of beans. Without pasta in the pot, the soup keeps up to 4 days in the fridge.

Source suggestions for swaps: fennel for celery; zucchini or yellow squash for (or with) green beans; fresh Roma tomatoes in summer; spinach or kale near the end; pearled farro or barley instead of pasta; homemade bean cooking liquid in place of some broth.
For a vegan bowl, skip the Parmesan (or use a vegan pesto garnish, as the source suggests).
Source lists a Dutch oven (Staub) under equipment; any large pot works.

flags.text: Card cook time is 30 minutes, but the steps add up to about 38 minutes of cooking (8 + 20 + 10). Using the card's stated prep (15) and cook (30); no total time is listed on the card.
Black pepper and red pepper flakes have no measured amounts in the source (several grinds / optional for heat).
Page byline also lists Phoebe Moore alongside Jeanine Donofrio; credited here to Jeanine Donofrio (Love and Lemons).
Source presents the recipe as vegetarian; Parmesan is optional for serving. Not tagged vegan—omit the cheese (or use a vegan garnish) for a vegan bowl.
